units.source_text: 至于不谙围棋，我和久米是五十步笑百步，彼此彼此。

en.t: As for not understanding go, Kume and I were much the same, the pot calling the kettle black.

units.source_text: 尽管这样，在旁连续观战，我不觉感到棋盘上不动的子，如同具有生命的精灵向你搭话一样。

en.t: Even so, as I sat beside the board watching game after game, I gradually felt that the motionless stones on the board were speaking to me like living spirits.

units.source_text: 棋手放棋子的声音，仿佛响彻了宏大的世界。

en.t: The sound of the players placing their stones seemed to ring out through a vast world.
